== claude-global / symlink to other file
== claude-global / symlink to other file / apply uninstall
apply uninstall plan prompt: "kander uninstall 将处理全局范围：\n  删除  <HOME>/.agents/kander 中 1 个 Kander 规则文件和状态文件，随后删除变空的目录\n  保留  <HOME>/.config/kander：配置目录\n各仓库中已提交的项目引用、任务分支与证据引用保留；需要回收时，请在卸载前运行 kander gc。\n"
apply uninstall: err=false
apply uninstall output: "已删除 <HOME>/.agents/kander 中 1 个 Kander 规则文件和状态文件\n"
apply uninstall config: unchanged true
apply uninstall file <HOME>/.claude/CLAUDE.md: symlink to <HOME>/.claude/other-rules.txt
apply uninstall file <HOME>/.claude/other-rules.txt: "# Other\n"

== claude-project / symlink to other file
detect: ok=false detail=<HOME>/project/CLAUDE.md 未导入或合并 KANDER-AGENTS.md
ensure: status=2 removed=0 inactive=false disabled=[]
followed: "# Other\n\n@~/.agents/kander/KANDER-AGENTS.md\n"
== claude-project / symlink escaping the scope

ensure: status=0 removed=0 inactive=false disabled=[] err=拒绝通过指向项目外的符号链接写入: <HOME>/project/CLAUDE.md
followed: "# Outside\n"
